# Glossary

Intro.

## A/B { #a-b }

The update scheme of a node's disk: two [slots](#slot), A and B. More text.

## Slot { #slot }
<!-- abbr: slots, Slots -->

One of the two partition pairs an `image` is written to.

## Image { #image }
<!-- abbr: none -->

A disk image.

## Effect { #effect }
<!-- abbr: nolower, Effects, effects -->

What a delivery does, e.g. a restart. More text.

## Secure Boot { #secure-boot }

The firmware's check of a boot binary, i.e. its signature. More text.
